calls.title: GrowthBook <> ECCO Technical Demo
calls.summary: The team is considering Growth Book as a cost-effective solution for scaling experimentation without the limitations of MTU-based billing, which currently affects usage of VWO at Ecco. Growth Book's ability to read data directly from Snowflake enhances data security and supports extensive experimentation. Integration concerns were addressed, highlighting Growth Book's flexibility with custom schemas and its support for existing data. The platform's feature flagging capabilities allow for targeted rollouts, requiring IT support for data handling. Budget discussions revealed that an enterprise tier is crucial for Ecco’s needs, with a plan to prepare a proposal for procurement. The team emphasized the importance of alignment and next steps, including a planned POC to validate integration and address stakeholder concerns.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Snowflake, experimentation, feature flagging, POC, Bloomreach
